title: Zodiac Reality Module on the legacy Safe: Invalid or No?
headline: A forum post says a question about a proposal that does not exist on Snapshot was submitted to the Reality module of GnosisDAO's legacy Safe, and argues the correct answer is No.
summary: The post says that on Nov 17 a question referencing proposal id gnosis-dao-old-treasury-full-sweep-i3081 was submitted to the Reality module of GnosisDAO's legacy Safe, and that Snapshot has no proposal with that id. Per the post, the asker answered Yes with 100 GNO, another wallet answered Invalid with 200 GNO, and the author answered No with 400 GNO; the No answer becomes final on Nov 20 at 13:32 UTC unless someone answers with 800 GNO. The author argues that the DAO's Proposal Acceptance Criteria list seven conditions for Yes and one case for Invalid, with all other cases resolving to No. The post also says questions from this module have no working arbitrator, so the largest bond decides, with a 100 GNO minimum that doubles with each answer, and suggests naming Kleros as arbitrator with a lower minimum bond. The author discloses holding the 400 GNO No answer and gaining 292.5 GNO if it stands. These are the poster's claims; the post links its sources.
risk_flags: no working arbitrator per the post
